stories.title: August ties with July 2023 as hottest month ever recorded
stories.summary: If you thought this summer was hot, you were right. NOAA confirms that this summer in the contiguous U.S. has smashed previous heat records. Globally, August was the hottest month on record.

stories.title: Here's what to know about the NFL season
stories.summary: The NFL regular season has kicked off. Among this year's changes, the league is rolling out a new three-strike policy for dangerous tackles.

stories.title: Amid war and sanctions, unemployment worsens in Iran
stories.summary: As the U.S. war with Iran drags on, Iranians face increasing layoffs and a rising unemployment rate.

stories.title: A fossil feather from the age of dinosaurs may explain why only some birds survived
stories.summary: An extremely well preserved fossil feather could reveal why some birds survived the dinosaur-killing asteroid, and others did not.

stories.title: 'Junk fees' make buying a home even more expensive
stories.summary: Real estate agents are sounding the alarm on a growing fee they say home buyers should not pay.

stories.title: Barbara Keating died in the 9/11 attack. She's finally being laid to rest
stories.summary: Barbara Keating died aboard one of the planes that hijackers slammed into the World Trade Center. Her remains were finally identified last year, and her family is gathering for a long-delayed funeral.
